name: Madeline Hotel & Residences, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This alpine sanctuary sits at 8,750 feet elevation, where luxury meets authentic mountain culture in one of Colorado's most exclusive ski destinations.
whats_special: The Madeline is perfectly positioned just steps from the Telluride Ski Resort's Village Express Lift, offering true ski-in/ski-out access. The hotel's rooftop pool and hot tub provide breathtaking 360-degree views of the San Juan Mountains, while the property's location in Mountain Village puts you at the heart of a car-free alpine paradise accessible only by gondola or chairlift.
pro_tip: Book treatments at Spa Madeline during "golden hour" – the floor-to-ceiling windows offer stunning sunset views over the peaks while you unwind after a day on the slopes.
dont_miss: Take the free gondola ride down to historic Telluride town – it's a scenic 13-minute journey through the box canyon that reveals why this former mining town is considered one of America's most beautiful ski destinations. The gondola runs until midnight, making evening dining in town effortlessly accessible.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location with direct mountain access
Full-service spa and comprehensive wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues with mountain cuisine and craft cocktails
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting mountain resort location
Seasonal accessibility dependent on mountain weather conditions
